title: Signal
tagline: Evidence-weighted findings in health, learning, technology and public safety. Updated daily. Nothing else.
about: Sources are journals, institutions and government feeds, chosen per item rather than from a fixed list. Every item is scored for whether it changes something you can do or decide, and most are discarded. There is no feed to scroll, no comments, and no algorithm learning what keeps you here.
author: AfrimMali
_security_contact: address for /.well-known/security.txt; blank emits no file
_subscribe: email signup. endpoint and turnstile_sitekey are public browser values and may instead come from the SUBSCRIBE_ENDPOINT and TURNSTILE_SITEKEY GitHub Actions variables. Google Form ids and the Turnstile secret belong only in Worker secrets. Blank browser values emit no subscribe page or nav link. unsubscribe is the address every mailing must carry; blank falls back to security_contact.
